correctness.rationale: Self-contained 24-vertex LCF presentation; BFS and Floyd-Warshall agree for every pair; girth, degree, diameter and distance histogram independently checked. An explicit sequence of all 96 elementary face/free-face deletions is replayed with a full coface check, leaving K1 exactly. At scale three, every pair excluded is distance four; exhaustive distances produce six connected two-regular C4 components, proving an exact independence-complex join. Each Ind(C4) is two contractible components, hence S0 up to homotopy; joining six gives S5. Enumeration of all 117648 faces independently matches (1+4t+2t²)^6. Barcode maps follow from the inclusion collapse, degree separation and eventual simplex. Limit: this proves only the stated finite graph, not any infinite classification.

value.rationale: The McGee graph is a canonical smallest cubic girth-seven cage, where the standard graph-power girth-collapse theorem stops at radius two. The exact structure of the first unstable radius-three graph is a natural, previously unresolved topological invariant: it becomes a nontrivial five-sphere through a sixfold join and gives the entire integral persistent barcode, not just Euler characteristic or a one-field Betti computation. The six four-cycle distance-four partition explains the result and can inform comparisons with other extremal cages; no broader theorem is required for the value of this natural complete classification.
